not_logged_in: The hub's Lark gateway is not signed in to Lark. Sign in again on the hub's machine.
upgrade_read: Update the hub and the Lark gateway to use message display settings.
read_failed: Couldn't read the settings. Try again once connected.
conflict: The settings or account changed. Reload them before changing.
upgrade_write: Update the Lark gateway to change these settings.
write_unknown: Not sure the change was saved. Reload the settings to check.
